name: io.github.smbcloudXYZ/ascapi
title: The App Stores Cooolest API
description: Forget Fastlane, this is the app stores coolest API.

packageArguments.name: --mcp
packageArguments.description: Run App Store Connect Signing as an MCP server over stdio.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: App Store Connect API key ID (Users and Access → Integrations → App Store Connect API).

environmentVariables.name: ASC_ISSUER_ID
environmentVariables.description: App Store Connect API issuer ID, shown on the same page as the key.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the .p8 private key for that API key. Defaults to ~/.appstoreconnect/private_keys/AuthKey_<key-id>.p8, matching Xcode's own convention.
